THE_QUESTION: Where was 2v2 Pole-A separation lost? Is the repaired pi_A, BEFORE the ATTACK/DEFEND split, already weak on Pole A relative to pi_B, or does the split (k=1: half the 2v2 team forced to DEFEND) weaken it?

STANDARDIZED_2V2_DIAG_PRESPLIT.pi_A: the repaired pi_A final as a plain policy: no role conditioning, no allocator, no frozen-attack splice (exactly how it was trained)

STANDARDIZED_2V2_DIAG_SPLIT.pi_A: the split composite exactly as in the confirmatory pass: pi_D on DEFEND + the repaired pi_A frozen on ATTACK, roles fixed for the episode, CLOSEST_DEFENDS k=1

CHECKPOINTS_locked.post_run_check: each sealed record's checkpoint hashes equal these pins

SEEDS.why_shared: the comparison is PAIRED: both arms play the same 128 seeds against the same pi_B, so pi_A(repaired) vs pi_A(split) on Pole A is read seed by seed. Registered once with both labels declared up front (evaluator --registry-experiment-id); SPENT only after both seal.
SEEDS.chosen_by: seed_registry next_free before this freeze; disjoint from every training, certification, exploratory and confirmatory block

INSTRUMENT.evaluator: experiments/eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.py --team-size 2, unchanged apart from the shared-block mode used here
INSTRUMENT.expected_cost: about 4.4 h per arm (the n=128 confirmatory took ~4.4 h), about 9 h for both

primary_quantities.delta_A_presplit: V(pi_A_repaired, A) - V(pi_B, A)   (from the PRESPLIT record)
primary_quantities.delta_A_split: V(pi_A+D, A) - V(pi_B, A)             (from the SPLIT record)
primary_quantities.split_effect_on_A: V(pi_A_repaired, A) - V(pi_A+D, A), paired by seed across the two records; same bootstrap

secondary_quantities.pi_B_consistency: pi_B plays identical seeds in both arms; its per-seed Pole A/B outcomes are compared across records and any disagreement is reported (it measures evaluation stochasticity, not a result)

interpretation.SPLIT_WEAKENS_A: split_effect_on_A mean > 0 with LCB95 > 0 -- the ATTACK/DEFEND split at k=1 costs Pole-A performance; investigate the split/defender stage, not the specialists
interpretation.WEAKNESS_PREDATES_SPLIT: split_effect_on_A LCB95 <= 0 AND delta_A_presplit is not clearly larger than delta_A_split -- Pole-A separation was already weak after foundation/entity repair; inspect the specialist trajectory, not role allocation
interpretation.SPLIT_HELPS_A: split_effect_on_A mean < 0 with UCB95 < 0 -- the split improves Pole A; the confirmatory shortfall is not the split
interpretation.note: exploratory, n=128: a point-estimate localization aid. It licenses a scientifically motivated next change; it is not a confirmatory claim and does not revise efe4ee3c.

LAUNCH.order: PRESPLIT, then SPLIT (sequential, one GPU); each arm is one-shot by label
LAUNCH.preflight: both commands with --dry-run must pass; the spec must be committed and clean

NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_SPEC: another confirmatory crossover, or any re-run of the confirmatory label
retraining, fine-tuning or modifying any checkpoint
changing k, the allocator, the splice or the gate
treating either arm's own gate as a pass/fail of the 2v2 system (the evaluator prints one; here only the READINGS apply)
